mapper.sql: select id, code, source_platform, platform_order_code, currency, customer_id, customer_address, follow_employee_id, follow_ratio, sale_employee_id, sale_ratio, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted ,shipping_method, order_time, delivery_time, discount_amount, remark, is_inbound_delivery, is_collected_shipping_cost, shipping_cost, order_finish_time,receive_status, receive_finish_time, exchange_rate, end_other_amount, end_amount,submit_order_time from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
select syo.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.sale_employee_id) as salesEmployeeName, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.follow_employee_id) as followEmployeeName, (select count(*) from sal_yt_order_sub where order_id = syo.id and is_deleted = 0) as subOrderCount, (select sum((select sum(syosi.price * syosi.number) from sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi where syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syosi.is_deleted = 0) + (case when syo.is_collected_shipping_cost = 1 then coalesce(syo.shipping_cost, 0) else 0 end)) from sal_yt_order_sub syos where syos.order_id = syo.id and syos.is_deleted = 0) as amount, syc.name as customerName, syc.code as customerCode from sal_yt_order as syo left join sal_yt_customer as syc on syc.id = syo.customer_id
syo.is_deleted=0 and syo.code like concat('%', #{code}, '%') and platform_order_code = #{platformOrderCode} and currency = #{currency} and customer_id = #{customerId} and syc.name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and syo.follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId} and sale_employee_id = #{saleEmployeeId} and syo.id in (select order_id from sal_yt_order_sub where sub_code like concat('%',#{subCode},'%')) and syo.id in (select order_id from sal_yt_order_sub as syob where order_type = #{orderType} and syob.is_deleted=0) and syo.status = #{status} and syo.order_status = #{orderStatus} and syo.id in ( select order_id from sal_yt_order_sub where id in (select order_sub_id from sal_yt_order_sub_item group by order_sub_id having min(status) = #{itemStatus}))
and syo.id in ( select distinct syos.order_id from sal_yt_order_sub syos inner join sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id inner join pro_yt_product pyp on syosi.product_id = pyp.id where syos.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.is_deleted = 0 and pyp.code like concat('%', #{productCode}, '%') )
order by syo.submit_order_time desc, syo.id desc

select syo.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.sale_employee_id) as salesEmployeeName, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.follow_employee_id) as followEmployeeName, (select count(*) from sal_yt_order_sub where order_id = syo.id and is_deleted = 0) as subOrderCount, (select sum((select sum(syosi.price * syosi.number) from sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi where syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syosi.is_deleted = 0) + (case when syos.is_collected_shipping_cost = 1 then coalesce(syos.shipping_cost, 0) else 0 end)) from sal_yt_order_sub syos where syos.order_id = syo.id and syos.is_deleted = 0) as amount, syc.name as customerName from sal_yt_order as syo left join sal_yt_customer as syc on syc.id = syo.customer_id where syo.is_deleted=0 and syo.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update sal_yt_order set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select COALESCE( sum( (select sum(syosi.price * syosi.number) from sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi where syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syosi.is_deleted = 0) + (case when syos.is_collected_shipping_cost = 1 then COALESCE(syos.shipping_cost, 0) else 0 end) ), 0 ) as total_amount from sal_yt_order as syo left join sal_yt_order_sub syos on syos.order_id = syo.id and syos.is_deleted = 0 where syo.is_deleted = 0 and syo.customer_id = #{customerId} and syo.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) and syo.status>=5
select MAX(syo.create_time) as last_order_time from sal_yt_order as syo where syo.is_deleted = 0 and syo.customer_id = #{customerId} and syo.status>=5
select * from sal_yt_order where source_platform=#{platform} and is_deleted=0

select * from sal_yt_order where (sale_employee_id=#{saleEmployeeId} or follow_employee_id= #{followEmployeeId}) and submit_order_time is not null and submit_order_time >= #{dataBelongTime} and submit_order_time <= #{dataBelongTimeEnd} and is_deleted=0
select * from sal_yt_order_sub where order_id=#{orderId} and is_deleted=0

select * from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0 and (sale_employee_id = #{saleEmployeeId} or follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId}) and order_finish_time is not null and receive_finish_time is not null and shipping_receive_finish_time is not null and greatest(order_finish_time, receive_finish_time, shipping_receive_finish_time) >= #{dataBelongTime} and greatest(order_finish_time, receive_finish_time, shipping_receive_finish_time) <= #{dataBelongTimeEnd}

select * from sal_yt_order where (sale_employee_id=#{saleEmployeeId} or follow_employee_id= #{followEmployeeId}) and create_time is not null and create_time >= #{yearTime} and create_time <= #{yesterdayTime} and is_deleted=0

select * from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0 and (sale_employee_id = #{saleEmployeeId} or follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId}) and create_time is not null and create_time >= #{yearTime} and create_time <= #{yesterdayTime} and (order_finish_time is not null or receive_finish_time is not null or shipping_receive_finish_time is not null)

select syo.* from sal_yt_order as syo inner join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.order_id = syo.id and syos.is_deleted = 0 inner join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id where syosi.id = #{orderItemId} and syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syo.is_deleted = 0

select * from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0 and (sale_employee_id = #{salesmanId} or follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId}) and create_time >= #{startDate} and create_time <= #{nowDate} and is_deleted=0

select * from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0 and (sale_employee_id = #{salesmanId} or follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId}) and create_time is not null and create_time >= #{startDate} and create_time <= #{nowDate} and (order_finish_time is not null or receive_finish_time is not null or shipping_receive_finish_time is not null) and is_deleted=0

select * from sal_yt_order where is_deleted = 0 and (sale_employee_id = #{salesmanId} or follow_employee_id = #{followEmployeeId}) and create_time >= #{startDate} and create_time <= #{nowDate} and is_deleted=0
select * from sal_yt_order where customer_id = #{customerId} and create_time is not null and is_deleted=0
select syo.* from sal_yt_order as syo left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.order_id = syo.id where syos.id = #{subOrderId} and syos.is_deleted=0 limit 1
